spans.s:
प्रु {c1c} A. (प्रवते)
1 To go, move.
--2 To jump, spring. --Caus. To
extend, reach as far as.

प्रुष् {vI.v} {c1c} P. (प्रोषति, प्रुष्ट)
1 To burn
consume.
--2 To reduce to ashes.
{vII.v} {c9c} P. (प्रुष्णाति)
1 To become wet
or moist.
--2 To pour out, sprinkle.
--3 To fill.

प्रुष्ट p. p. Burnt, consumed,
reduced to ashes.

1 The rainy season.
--2
The sun.
--3 A drop of water (Sk.).
